guide.summary: Council prioritized critical free-space pressure on the system volume before any secondary tuning.
guide.chiefVerdict: Reclaim space on the system drive first, then rerun the full audit to confirm the warning cleared.

councilDiscussion.content: Free space on C: is below the safe threshold and blocks reliable update and paging behavior.
councilDiscussion.headline: Disk pressure

steps.title: Open Storage settings
steps.instructions: Open Storage settings and remove temporary files, old Windows Update cleanup, and large downloads from the system volume.

steps.title: Empty Recycle Bin
steps.instructions: Empty the Recycle Bin and confirm at least 10 GB of free space remains on the system drive before continuing.
